title: Meretz - Israeli Election Ad 2013 (English Subtitles)
description:
Click on "CC" if captions do not play automatically.

Guiding Questions
- The advert claims that only Meretz is really left wing, do you think that this is the case?
- Israeli politics has a growing number of centrist parties, is this the sign of a maturing democracy or a less ideological generation?
- The advert ends by personally naming Bibi (Benjamin Netanyahu), how did you react to this?
- Is this again the politics of personality at play, or does Bibi representant something larger?

Meretz is a left-wing social-democratic party, formed in 1992 by a conglomeration of three political parties. They are known for being strongly pro-two state solution and supporting minority rights and sexual and religious freedoms. They currently have 3 seats and are projected to win 4-5 seats in the upcoming elections on January 22nd.

This youtube channel is an educational resource provided by the Israel Engagement Department of the Jewish Federation of Greater Washington.

The Jewish Federation of Greater Washington supports Israeli democracy and not any particular political party in Israel. This channel is aimed at being a resource to understand Israeli democracy and not to promote any political platform.
